steps.what: Show the points already agreed for this media interview.
Promote the music by participating in the media interview and the other agreed activities.
Refuse a question that is not among the agreed points.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the points already agreed for the interview. The musician promotes the group's music by doing the media interview and the other activities that were agreed. A question outside those points is refused by the musician. The points do not speak. No answer is drafted. An interview with no agreed points leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed points were a mail, and a live question went past them because the mail was not to hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Agreed points can be shown during the interview. Speaking, and refusing a question, stay with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: A live interview moves off the page, and only the musician can refuse the question.
tasks.human_edge: The musician does the interview. The agreed points are a boundary, not the answers.
tasks.altitude: The interview stays with the musician. Agreed points are visible, no answer is drafted, and a question outside them is refused by the musician.

reach.task: Do a press interview from points already agreed.
reach.learn: The points are not the interview.

evidence.claim: Showing points already agreed is a lookup. It does not promote the music and does not answer an interview.
No answer is drafted or published. The musician speaks, and refuses what was not agreed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The interview id and the agreed points only if already written. Answers are not generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the points from the document store.
unknowns: Whether the other activities are in-person appearances or only interviews.
research_questions: Who agrees the points before the musician will do the interview?

already_counted.description: Doing the interview and refusing an unagreed question stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Retire agreed points after the interview has run.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still does the interview and still refuses a question that was not agreed. Only showing points already written is removed. No answer is drafted, and an interview with no points saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research the role from held pages.

steps.what: Keep only sentences that name the place or the period on a held page.

loop.purpose: Bind each sentence to a page the company already holds.
loop.input: The programme note or the score preface already held.
loop.output: Sentences that name the place or the period and cite a page id.
loop.check: Each sentence cites a page id and the page states that place or period.
loop.stop: No page id, or the page does not state the sentence.
loop.why_not_simpler: A general history note cannot tell which sentence is not in the material the company holds.

steps.what: Research the role and write what the character or the setting requires.
File the accepted research note for that piece.

tasks.design: A draft in {DOCS} keeps a sentence only when a page the company already holds states that place or that period, and it stops otherwise. The musician researches the particular role and writes what the character, or the time and place of the piece, requires. The accepted note is filed only after that writing, for that version. The draft is not the research. Pages that do not state the sentence are not used. Nothing is published from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Background on a role was a search the musician could not point back to a page in the score or the programme note.
tasks.enabler_now: A sentence can be kept only with a page id from material already held. The musician still writes what the role requires.
tasks.still_hard: What a character requires of the singing is the musician's conclusion, not a sentence on a preface page.
tasks.human_edge: The musician writes the note and accepts the version that is filed. A cited sentence is not that conclusion.
tasks.altitude: The musician still writes what the role requires. A note is filed only after the musician accepts it, and only sentences from held pages are offered.

reach.task: Read the text they were given before deciding the character.
reach.learn: A cited line is not the decision.

evidence.claim: A sentence can be kept when a page the company already holds states it. A sentence with no page is dropped. That is not a history of the role.
The research note is what the musician writes and accepts. It is not published from this task, and the draft is not the note.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The page id in the programme note or the score preface the company holds. A sentence with no page id is dropped. The character conclusion is written by the musician. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read only the materials already in the document store. Do not search outside them.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the musician.
unknowns: Whether programme notes are held as text or only as unscanned paper.
research_questions: Which held documents may be used: the score preface, the programme note, or both?

already_counted.description: Writing what the role requires stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Drop research notes for pieces that were cut.

approvals.approved_version: note version and the page ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still writes what the character or the setting requires and still accepts the note before it is filed. The draft removes only the hunt for a sentence already on a held page. Material with no citable page saves nothing, and nothing is published.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The musician still does the interview and still writes what a role requires. A draft may repeat a sentence that is already in a held page, and the musician accepts the note before it is filed.
reach: Actors research a character from the text they were given, and this job learns a page cite is not the conclusion.
Art directors speak for a work in public, and this job learns agreed points are not the interview.
skills_to_grow: Do the interview from points already agreed, and refuse any other.
Write the research note from pages the company holds, and accept it before it is filed.
role.ambitious_version: Interviews stay with the musician. A research note is filed only after the musician has accepted a version whose sentences cite a held page.
